cartridge_mod.controls.arcade.tooltip: Cartridge: Arcade's cabinets: a stick, six buttons, Coin, Start and P2 Start (for a two-player game). Which button does what is up to each game (in Street Fighter II, 1 to 3 punch and 4 to 6 kick).
cartridge_arcade.check.not_set: %s isn't a MAME romset: choose the set's zip, named as MAME names it (sf2.zip)
cartridge_arcade.check.unknown: MAME %2$s doesn't know a game called %1$s
cartridge_arcade.check.ready: %s: MAME runs it. Ready to burn
cartridge_arcade.check.needs: %s also needs files from %s: choose it
cartridge_arcade.check.other_version: This romset is from another MAME version than %s: %s missing
cartridge_arcade.help.arcade_cabinet.1: Right-click it with an Arcade Board to put the board in, then press POWER in its menu.
cartridge_arcade.help.arcade_cabinet.2: Right-click the control panel to play; Esc to stop. Credits are free: press Coin.
cartridge_arcade.help.arcade_cabinet.3: Link it to a TV with an AV Cable if you like. Dye it in a crafting grid.
Right-click it with an Arcade Board to put the board in, then press POWER in its menu.
Right-click the left half of the control panel for Player 1, the right half for Player 2; Esc to stop.
Credits are free: press Coin. Dye it in a crafting grid.
cartridge_arcade.help.blank_arcade_board: Burn a MAME romset zip onto it in a Cartridge Writer.
cartridge_arcade.help.arcade_board.1: Right-click an Arcade Cabinet with it to put it in.
cartridge_arcade.help.arcade_board.2: Copy or erase it in a Cartridge Writer, like a cartridge.
